mainEntity.name: What is an AI PR consultant and who is it for?

acceptedAnswer.text: An AI PR consultant is a specialist who runs media strategy for AI startups, translating technical products into stories that tier-1 journalists, investors and enterprise buyers can follow. The best fit is a fractional senior operator rather than a generalist agency, because the person pitching editors is the person who understands your model, your architecture and your market. Shilika Jain runs AI startup PR directly for $5K–$12K/month and has placed founders in Forbes, CoinDesk, Decrypt and Benzinga.

mainEntity.name: How much does an AI PR consultant cost?

acceptedAnswer.text: A fractional senior specialist typically runs $5K–$12K per month, which removes the multi-person account-team markup of a $15K–$45K generalist agency retainer. A focused launch sprint for a funding announcement, product launch or major partnership runs $15K–$40K over four to eight weeks.

mainEntity.name: Which outlets can you get an AI startup into?

acceptedAnswer.text: Tier-1 AI and tech: Forbes, TechCrunch, Wired, VentureBeat, The Information where the story warrants it. Crypto-adjacent: CoinDesk, Decrypt, The Block, Blockworks, Benzinga. Podcasts: covers placed across six-plus AI and tech podcast circuits in recent campaigns. AI Magazine and specialist newsletters for sustained thought leadership. Every placement follows a real news hook, not a wire blast or paid distribution.

mainEntity.name: What does the process and timeline look like?

acceptedAnswer.text: The first two weeks cover a press footprint teardown, a category positioning session and a journalist and KOL map for your beat. Week three to four is outreach, embargo placement and KOL seeding. Week five onward is sustained coverage, AI-citation monitoring and the next news hook. For a launch sprint the full cycle runs four to eight weeks. For a monthly retainer, the first major placement typically lands within the first four to six weeks.

mainEntity.name: How do I get started with an AI PR consultant?

acceptedAnswer.text: Send a short project brief through the intent form and you will get a reply within 24 hours with a quick read on your press footprint and the one story worth telling right now. Or book a 30-minute call and we will plot it live. No introductory deck, no account-team onboarding call.
